tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Latar halaman (60%). Warna kertas pembungkus daging yang hangat, bukan abu dingin.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Kartu, tabel, panel, modal, bottom sheet.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Header tabel, sel jadwal kosong, field read-only, chip status Libur.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Garis pemisah dan tepi kartu dekoratif (tidak membawa makna).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Tepi input, checkbox, dan kontrol (minimal 3:1 di bg dan surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Teks utama di bg, surface, surface-sunken, dan semua *-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Teks sekunder, label field, timestamp, keterangan di bg, surface, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Hijau-biru Rantai Dingin (30%): tombol utama, link, tab aktif, ikon aktif, header kiosk. Teks brand di bg dan surface lolos 7:1.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover dan pressed tombol utama.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Latar item navigasi aktif, baris terpilih, sel jadwal terisi.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Teks dan ikon di atas brand atau brand-hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Terakota Daging (10%): sorotan langka, seri data kedua di grafik, angka take-home pay di slip. Bukan untuk status atau tombol.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Latar sorotan accent (kartu ringkasan payroll).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status Hadir, Disetujui, Payroll terkunci. Selalu disertai teks atau ikon.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Latar chip dan banner success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status Terlambat, Menunggu approval, Perlu review, sertifikat akan kedaluwarsa.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Latar chip dan banner warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status Mangkir, Ditolak, error validasi, aksi destruktif.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Latar chip, banner, dan field error.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Status Cuti, Izin, Sakit, Tugas Luar; pesan informasi.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Latar chip dan banner info.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Cincin fokus 2px solid dengan offset 2px di semua kontrol (7:1 di bg dan surface).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Jarak ikon ke teks di dalam chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Jarak antar chip, antar baris label-nilai.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding chip dan sel tabel padat.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gutter halaman mobile, padding kartu.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Jarak antar section, padding modal.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gutter halaman desktop, jarak antar blok besar.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Tinggi minimum tombol, input, dan item list di aplikasi karyawan (bisa dipakai bersarung tangan).

tokens.name: tap-target-kiosk
tokens.usage: Tinggi minimum tombol dan tuts PIN di kiosk.

tokens.name: control-height-dense
tokens.usage: Tinggi kontrol di tabel web admin (desktop saja).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chip status, sel jadwal, checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tombol, input, kartu.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet, modal, kartu absen utama.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tombol bulat Absen Masuk/Pulang, avatar.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Hanya untuk modal, bottom sheet, dan dropdown. Kartu biasa memakai border, bukan bayangan.
